name: primitives-texts-gradient

frames.best_why: The gradient peaks in vivid pink across both lines and the neon halo on the lower line is strongest.

tagline: Headline text shaded in a slowly drifting blue-to-pink gradient.
summary: Two lines of bold display text with a looping blue, purple and pink gradient; the second line repeats itself as a soft blurred glow.
appearance: Two lines of large sans-serif text on black: a bold headline across the top and a slightly smaller line below. The letters carry a blue, purple and pink gradient, and the lower line has a soft glowing halo.
behaviour: The gradient scrolls sideways through the letters in an endless slow loop, so the colours drift from blue to pink and back. The lower line's blurred copy brightens in step.
demo_content: The lines Beautiful animations and made effortless.
search_phrases: text with a moving color gradient
gradient words for a landing page
use_when: A hero or section headline should feel alive without a moving background.
avoid_when: The gradient is hardcoded, and the pale blues and glows would lose contrast on a light page.
customise: Pass the text string, choose a gradient string and turn the neon glow on or off; the scroll distance and looping transition are props too.
weight_why: Two text spans with a looping background position; no layout cost.

a11y.note: It animates forever and never checks prefers-reduced-motion, so the gradient keeps drifting for motion-sensitive readers.

issues: The glow under the second line turns yellowish, which clashes with the blue and pink.
The headline's gradient barely changes across the first few frames, so movement is slow to notice.
polish_why: Bold type and a smooth drifting gradient; the yellowish glow fringe is the only blemish.
title: Gradient Text
